description: This file defines the ReadableCustomerOptionValue class, which extends CustomerOptionValueEntity and includes a CustomerOptionValueDescription. It implements Serializable and provides getter and setter methods for the description field.

classes.name: ReadableCustomerOptionValue
classes.description: A class representing a read-only customer option value with an associated description, extending CustomerOptionValueEntity and implementing Serializable.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description object for this customer option value.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description object for this customer option value.
